name: safemigrate
description: Zero-Downtime Migration Sandbox — Docker Postgres shadow clone, schema diff, rollback SQL

scripts.build: npm run build -w @safemigrate/core && npm run build -w @safemigrate/docker && npm run build -w @khyfee/safemigrate && npm run build -w @safemigrate/action && npm run build -w @safemigrate/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @safemigrate/core && npm run build -w @safemigrate/docker && npm run build -w @khyfee/safemigrate && npm run test -w @safemigrate/core && npm run test -w @safemigrate/docker && npm run test -w @khyfee/safemigrate && npm run test -w @safemigrate/action

author: KhyFee (https://github.com/KhyFee)
